subject: Follow-up on service information
text:
Hi there,
I'm following up on the service overview I asked about two days ago, since we need to finalize our event logistics shortly. Could you please share any information you have on scheduling options, cancellation terms, and whether on-site support is included? A brief list of available packages would also help us compare choices before our next planning meeting. If you haven't heard back from the provider yet, let me know and I can send a separate reminder. I appreciate your help keeping this moving, and please flag any details that might affect the budget. The sooner we have those clear answers, the easier it will be to lock in a solid plan without last-minute pressure.
